body:
## Finding

The reference-check panel promises a future automated reminder on a row the landlord has **taken over manually**.

On `reference_panel.gleam`, the attempt-log cadence hint keys only on the call status:

```gleam
let has_next_reminder = case call.status {
  ContactInitiated -> list.length(send_batches(call.attempt_log)) < 4
  _ -> False
}
```

A taken-over `contact_initiated` row still renders **"Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply"** — while the sweep that would send that reminder explicitly excludes taken-over rows (`sweep_due_reference_calls.sql`: `AND rc.taken_over_at IS NULL`). The takeover toast itself says "automated messages stopped". The hint is a promise the system will not keep.

## Reproduction (develop @ 7675c81, sandbox fixture)

1. Open the reference panel for a fixture app whose employer_ref is `contact_initiated` with 1 delivered invite attempt.
2. Expand the row → hint "Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply" shows (correct pre-takeover).
3. Overflow menu → **Take over manually** → confirm.
4. Row now shows "You're handling this one" — but the attempt log **still** shows "Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply".

## Screenshot

![taken-over reminder hint](https://github.com/solarity-services/RightTenantry/releases/download/bug-hunt-screenshots/bug-hunt2-taken-over-reminder-hint-1786752911.png)

## Evidence

- Live DOM (post-takeover): row contains both `You're handling this one` and `Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply`.
- Sweep SQL excludes taken-over rows (`sweep_due_reference_calls.sql:59` — `taken_over_at IS NULL`), so the promised reminder never fires.
- Scenario `reference_checks/taken-over-reminder-hint.yaml` (in `.pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/reference_checks/`) reproduces and fails on current develop.
- Environment: sandbox (local Docker Postgres + server on :4101), branch `rt-refcheck-bughunt2` @ `7675c81`.
- Run at: 2026-08-15T00:1x local.

## Suggested fix (for the bosses)

Gate the hint on the taken-over flag — e.g. `ContactInitiated if not taken_over(call) -> batch_count < 4`, or drop the hint whenever the row is taken over. One-line panel change; a scenario pin already exists.

## Constraints

- Fix application code, not the scenario.
- Re-run with `/bug-hunt reference_checks taken-over-reminder-hint` — expected PASS.
- No regressions in sibling scenarios.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified
- [ ] Fix landed
- [ ] `/bug-hunt reference_checks taken-over-reminder-hint` passes
